entries.section: CONTROL INTERFACE BLOCKS
entries.description: CONTROL INTERFACE BLOCK FORMAT: (1) TAG NUMBER OF INTERFACING COMPONENT (2) ACTION OR SIGNAL OF ITEM 1 (3) ACTION OR SIGNAL OF RELATED DEVICE
entries.notes: Intro: CONTROL INTERFACE BLOCKS ARE SHOWN ON P&ID'S TO INDICATE IN AN OVERVIEW FASHION THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN INSTRUMENT CHANNELS AND CONTROLLED DEVICES. THE DETAILS ARE FOUND ON THE CONTROL LOGIC DIAGRAM. A CONTROL INTERFACE BLOCK IS A TABLE WITH THREE COLUMNS IN THE FORMAT SHOWN BELOW.

entries.section: CONTROL INTERFACE BLOCKS
entries.description: EXAMPLE: TICA100 | H | OP - V022 OPENS ON HIGH SIGNAL FROM TICA 100 (block at controlled valve V022)

entries.section: CONTROL INTERFACE BLOCKS
entries.description: EXAMPLE: V022 | OP | H - V022 OPENS ON HIGH SIGNAL FROM TICA 100 (block at instrument TICA 100 / TE 100)

entries.section: CONTROL INTERFACE BLOCKS
entries.description: THE TAG NUMBERS MAY BE OMITTED FROM THE CONTROL INTERFACE BLOCK IF THE COMPONENTS ARE IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO EACH OTHER

entries.section: CONTROL INTERFACE BLOCKS
entries.description: FOR COMPLEX LOGIC, REFERENCES TO NOTES MAY REPLACE ITEMS IN COLUMNS 1.2. OR 3. (EXAMPLES: MK-01A | NOTE 9; MP-05B | SEE NOTE 5; V100 | OP | H; V100 | CL | L)

entries.section: CONTROL INTERFACE BLOCKS
entries.description: IF A COMPONENT IN COLUMN 1 IS ON A DIFFERENT DRAWING, REFERENCE THE DRAWING NUMBER IN COLUMN 1.

entries.section: CONTROL INTERFACE BLOCKS
entries.description: EXAMPLE: OP | H (TAG NUMBERS OMITTED) - V022 OPENS ON HIGH SIGNAL FROM TICA 100

entries.section: CONTROL INTERFACE BLOCKS
entries.description: EXAMPLE: V100 | CL | L / V200 CAS-M6-002 | OP | H
entries.notes: VALVE V100 IS PART OF CAS AND IS LOCATED ON SHEET 1 ALONG WITH THE CONTROLLING DEVICE. V200 IS LOCATED ON SHEET 2 AND IS CONTROLLED BY THE SAME DEVICE. IF V200 WERE A PART OF ANOTHER SYSTEM (E.G. BDS), THEN THE SAME METHOD WOULD BE USED.
